+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.aix import AIXHardware
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('threads_output, expected_threads', [
+    ('smt_threads 4 SMT threads True\n', 4),
+    ('', 1),
+])
+def test_cpu_facts(threads_output, expected_threads):
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [
+        (0, 'proc0 Available Processor\nproc1 Defined Processor\nproc2 Available Processor\n', ''),
+        (0, 'type PowerPC_POWER7 Processor type False\n', ''),
+        (0, threads_output, ''),
+    ]
+
+    facts = AIXHardware(module).get_cpu_facts()
+
+    assert facts == {
+        'processor': ['PowerPC_POWER7'],
+        'processor_count': 1,
+        'processor_cores': 2,
+        'processor_threads_per_core': expected_threads,
+        'processor_vcpus': 2 * expected_threads,
+    }
